text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the Dojo Invitational! In this corner stands yours truly, the announcer who also builds fighters, so go easy on me. This time I fussed over one hairline: about thirty-one hundred fine hairs and a faint shadow painted into the skin, so the edge of that hair cap finally softens. She passes every automated check, but her realism score comes from the owner, not the judge. No grading my own homework, folks! Standing one point seven three meters, the patient counter-striker in terracotta, CLAUDE!
